title: Developing bdhs
text: Key contracts: bdhs_read() returns tibble lower-case names, haven labels kept attributes bdhs_survey_id, bdhs_recode, bdhs_file. data_survey_id(data) / data_recode(data) detect otherwise. Pooled data carry survey_id column (is_pooled()). bdhs_design(data, weight, strata, survey, recode, srvyr) returns survey.design2: PSU v021/hv021/mv021, strata v022 (DHS sampling-error strata, every round), weight *005 / 1e6, nest = TRUE; pooled data use round-prefixed PSUs/strata pool_wt. Evaluate variances options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust") set locally. bdhs_estimate() returns tibble class bdhs_estimate: survey_id, indicator, label, -columns, estimate, se, ci_low, ci_high, n_unweighted, n_weighted, api_id; attributes level, scale, by_labels. Proportions 0-100 scale. Indicators new_indicator() objects R/indicator-defs-*.R (universe, value, all_women, window, rounds, api_id, params). bdhs_official() returns tidy official values (bdhs_indicators), preferred = FALSE exposing alternative reference periods (by_variable_label). Internal helpers R/utils.R: zap_all(), as_codes(), var_label(), lower_names(), first_present(), check_installed(), cli_escape(); dv(d, var) (numeric codes column, R/indicators.R).

title: Survey design, weights and pooling
text: bdhs_pool() stacks rounds, adds survey_id column builds pooled weight pool_wt. bdhs_design() gives every round strata clusters: three weighting choices : "normalized": DHS weights . Rounds count proportion sample size. DHS Program’s recommendation pooled estimates describe population. "equal": every round carries total weight. title: Socioeconomic inequality in an indicator — bdhs_inequality
text: Let groups ordered poorest (1) richest (\(K\)), weighted population shares \(p_k\) indicator's denominator population, let \(R_k = \sum_{j<k} p_j + p_k / 2\) weighted ridit (fractional rank) group \(k\), \(R\) runs 0 (poorest) 1 (richest). difference: \(\mu_K - \mu_1\) (richest minus poorest group), ratio: \(\mu_K / \mu_1\). group means estimated jointly (survey::svyby() covmat = TRUE) measures survey::svycontrast() (delta method; ratio's interval computed log scale). sii, slope index inequality: slope \(\beta\) design-based linear regression \(E(y) = \alpha + \beta R\) 0/1 outcome ridit (survey::svyglm()); absolute difference top bottom socioeconomic scale (Barros Victora 2013). rii, relative index inequality: \(\exp(\beta)\) log-link (quasi-Poisson) regression \(\log E(y) = \alpha + \beta R\), ratio predicted values top bottom scale (Barros Victora 2013). ci, concentration index, covariance ("convenient regression") form design weights, \(C = 2\,\mathrm{cov}_w(y,   R) / \mu\) (Kakwani, Wagstaff van Doorslaer 1997; Wagstaff, Paci van Doorslaer 1991). written smooth function survey totals, \(C = 2 T_{yR} / T_y - 2 T_R / N\), standard error obtained linearization survey::svycontrast(). eci, Erreygers' corrected concentration index bounded outcome \([, b]\): \(E = 4 \mu C / (b - ) = 8\,\mathrm{cov}_w(y, R)\) binary outcome (Erreygers 2009); proportions. Positive values difference, sii, ci eci (ratio, rii 1) mean indicator higher among richer. Ridits treated fixed (conditional observed group shares), usual. Proportions 0-100 scale, difference sii percentage points; measures scale-free. Indicators -women denominators (ratio estimators) get difference ratio . Lonely PSUs handled options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust"), set function runs.

text: Computes inequality measures bdhs_inequality() official DHS estimates wealth quintile (bdhs_official()), every round estimates. point estimates (official tables carry covariances). measures follow group values \(\mu_k\) weighted denominators \(p_k\) five quintiles: difference \(\mu_5 - \mu_1\), ratio \(\mu_5 / \mu_1\), sii rii weighted (least squares log-link) regression \(\mu_k\) ridit \(R_k\), equals individual-level regression ridit constant within groups, ci \(= 2 \sum_k p_k \mu_k R_k / \mu - 1\) eci \(= 4 \mu C\) (percentages, \(\mu\) proportion). Official values rounded, measures approximate.
